outcome: Composite of neonatal morbidity and mortality
cohort: 1984 pregnant women booked for care between March 2019 - June 2019 and March 2020 - June 2020
finding: While there were no significant differences in perinatal mental health outcomes or perinatal mortality between the pre-pandemic and pandemic groups, there was a concerning increase in the composite outcome of adverse neonatal outcomes during the pandemic.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in mode of delivery between the pre-pandemic and pandemic groups.
